prerequisites: Set GUEST_TREE_A and GUEST_TREE_B to two isolated worktrees with identical current source bytes after C integration. Record each commit and any source diff.
Set GUEST_EVIDENCE to a new directory under the main repository docs/perf tree. Set GUEST_TEST_ROOT to the integrated root with its own warm native target.
Each worktree owns separate empty target/guest-digest-proof and target/guest-digest-app directories. Do not reuse one worktree target from the other.
capture:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p -- "$GUEST_EVIDENCE"
for side in a b; do
  if [[ "$side" == a ]]; then tree="$GUEST_TREE_A"; else tree="$GUEST_TREE_B"; fi
  test ! -e "$tree/target/guest-digest-proof"
  test ! -e "$tree/target/guest-digest-app"
  git -C "$tree" rev-parse HEAD > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-commit.txt"
  git -C "$tree" diff --binary HEAD > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-source.diff"
  (
    cd "$tree"
    CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$tree/target/guest-digest-proof" RUSTC_WRAPPER= \
      ./tools/build-components build-only proof \
      > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-proof.json" 2> "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-proof-build.log"
    (
      cd "$tree/target/guest-digest-proof/wasm32-wasip2/release"
      LC_ALL=C sha256sum -- *.wasm > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-all-raw.sha256"
    )
    CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$tree/target/guest-digest-proof" RUSTC_WRAPPER= \
      ./tools/build-components virtualize-only "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-proof.json" \
      > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-virtualize.log" 2>&1
    CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$tree/target/guest-digest-app" RUSTC_WRAPPER= \
      ./tools/build-components build-only app \
      apps/wamn_receiving apps/wamn_wms apps/client_acme_receiving \
      > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-app.json" 2> "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-app-build.log"
  )
done
compare:
set -euo pipefail
diff -u "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/a-all-raw.sha256" "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/b-all-raw.sha256" \
  > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/all-raw-diff.log"
(
  cd "$GUEST_TEST_ROOT"
  WAMN_DIGEST_REPRO_A="$GUEST_TREE_A/target/guest-digest-proof/virtualized/std-empty-environment" \
  WAMN_DIGEST_REPRO_B="$GUEST_TREE_B/target/guest-digest-proof/virtualized/std-empty-environment" \
    cargo test --locked --offline -p wamn-proof-conformance --test guest_workspace_closure \
    one_commit_built_in_two_checkouts_yields_identical_guest_digests \
    -- --include-ignored --exact --nocapture \
    > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/virtualized-comparison.log" 2>&1
  for side in a b; do
    WAMN_DIGEST_PROFILE_APP_PLAN="$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-app.json" \
    WAMN_DIGEST_PROFILE_PROOF_PLAN="$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-proof.json" \
      cargo test --locked --offline -p wamn-proof-conformance --test guest_workspace_closure \
      one_commit_built_under_two_profiles_yields_identical_guest_digests \
      -- --include-ignored --exact --nocapture \
      > "$GUEST_EVIDENCE/$side-app-proof-comparison.log" 2>&1
  done
)
notes: The build tool selects all guest workspace members in proof mode and uses one Cargo invocation for each guest. The raw list also includes no_std and test guests.
The existing cross-checkout Rust test compares virtualized std outputs. The existing app/proof test compares raw artifact-plan hashes for the three named apps.
An earlier layout can have different digests because this mechanical move changes Cargo package paths. This comparison establishes reproducibility of the final layout before pins are updated.
These are command instructions only. No guest build or comparison ran in this subtask.
